snippet.title: Folio Detective - Official Gameplay Trailer for Desktop | Mystery Game
snippet.description:
Can you solve the mystery in 1840s Paris? 🔎

Folio Detective is an investigation game inspired by classic and horror literature. Interrogate suspects using free-text interrogation, gather clues, and complete your investigation report to unmask the killer.

🖥️ PLAY NOW ON STEAM:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5535100/Folio_Detective/

📱 DOWNLOAD NOW ON GOOGLE PLAY:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.pmakers.games.folio.detective

💬 JOIN OUR DISCORD COMMUNITY:
https://discord.gg/a8xMgBB3zX

Key Features:

Free-text interrogation system (interrogate suspects using your own words)

Atmospheric 1840s Paris crime scenes

Deductive investigation report mechanics

Story inspired by classic detective literature
